name: Karashima Naoto
source: Naoto is the apartment manager of the apartment building he lives in with his grandfather. He is a lazy, otaku hikikomori who plans to create a harem for himself despite his introverted personality. Most of the time the only thing that motivates him to do his job is the threat of being cursed by Tama.
